title: RootDown: Deploying and Benchmarking Models for Beet-Root Detection on Edge Devices
abstract: arXiv:2610.32275v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quality inspection of sugar beets after harvest and storage is critical to preserve sugar content and ensure optimal processing efficiency. The transfer of harvested beets to field clamps or trucks provides an opportunity to visually inspect individual beets automatically on loader conveyors. However, this is a challenging task as the large number of beets causes partial overlap and occlusion, complicating both annotation and detection. In this work, we propose an end-to-end image-based pipeline for detecting partially occluded sugar beets in loading scenarios as a first step toward automated quality inspection. We introduce a dedicated benchmark and present an automatic annotation strategy that leverages the SAM 3 foundation model to generate bounding boxes. translated_title: RootDown：在边缘设备上部署与基准测试甜菜根检测模型
translated_abstract: 甜菜收获和储存后的质量检测对于保持糖分含量并确保最佳加工效率至关重要。将收获的甜菜转移至田间堆垛或卡车的过程中，为在装载输送带上对单个甜菜进行自动目视检查提供了机会。然而，这是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为大量的甜菜会造成部分重叠和遮挡，使得标注和检测都变得复杂。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种端到端的基于图像的流水线，用于在装载场景中检测部分遮挡的甜菜，作为迈向自动化质量检测的第一步。我们引入了一个专门的基准数据集，并提出了一种利用 SAM 3 基础模型生成边界框的自动标注策略。我们比较了在人工标注标签与自动生成标签上训练的模型。此外，我们还研究了部署方面的考量，对多种推理配置进行了基准测试。
tldr: 该论文提出了 RootDown 端到端图像检测流水线，结合基于 SAM 3 的自动标注策略与专用基准数据集，在边缘设备上实现了装载场景中部分遮挡甜菜的检测，为甜菜自动化质量检测迈出第一步。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RootDown, an end-to-end image-based pipeline leveraging a SAM 3-based automatic annotation strategy and a dedicated benchmark to detect partially occluded sugar beets on edge devices, as a first step toward automated quality inspection.
